cardOverview.overviewText: The Standard Chartered Beyond Credit Card awards 5 reward points for every ₹150 spent on general purchases (≈ 3.33% effective reward), and 3 points per ₹150 on utilities, supermarkets, insurance, and similar essential spends (≈ 2% reward).It also includes perks such as lounge access and lifestyle/privilege benefits under SC’s Priority‑banking offering.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: 25% Off upto ₹2500|Min. bill value ₹2500.|Valid once per card per month
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the EazyDiner app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy 5% cashback up to ₹250 every month. Complete the payment using your RBL TVS Credit Gold credit card to unlock the offer.
